content: LangExtract (Google, experimental, not officially supported) grounds each extraction to a source span; ports document alignment statuses exact/lesser/fuzzy/not_found with fuzzy LCS threshold ~0.75 and offsets relative to the original document even when chunked. Anthropic Citations API returns cited_text with char_location (text), page_location (PDF, 1-based) or content_block_location; citations only point to provided documents. FRONT (2024) quote-first-then-answer improves citation quality. Fuzzy acceptance is weaker than the verbatim gate this project needs.
